calls.title: Growthbook <> 18 Birdies - Demo
calls.summary: The discussion centered around the potential for GrowthBook to replace Statsig, enhancing experimentation through AI-driven workflows and integrating with Mixpanel. Key issues included data discrepancies, with 10% of Mixpanel and Statsig data not aligning, impacting decision-making. The need for data warehouse integration was emphasized to ensure accurate metrics. GrowthBook is actively developing funnel and retention analytics, alongside session replay and user journey visualizations, with plans for immediate updates on its feature roadmap. Collaborative efforts with 18 Birdies' engineering team were highlighted to streamline adoption and integration processes.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Statsig, Mixpanel, data warehouse, AI experimentation, analytics roadmap
calls.action_items:
